lines: I.  Introduction

A design buys observations to certify the Top-k of a set of relations ranked by CAPACITY — the range max_a θ_ra − min_a θ_ra. Certifying means excluding every alternative that would change the answer, so the design's value is the cheapest such alternative.

Three quantities must be kept distinct. J_scalar is the pair-flip value computed at the CURRENT extrema with ordering constraints dropped; J_old is the quadratic programme inside the current-extrema region; J_full is the infimum over the whole alternative set, with the extrema free in either relation. III.  Results

THE TWO FAMILIES SEPARATE WITHOUT LIMIT. As η → 0 one family drives the ratio to zero and the other to infinity — PROVED bounds in exact arithmetic, not sampled points. ON RANDOM INSTANCES THE FAILURE IS PREDICTABLE. Over 6000 drawn instances, all 1367 on which the proxy overstates have a moving extremum, and none with fixed extrema does. IV.  Discussion

THE PROXY'S FAILURE IS PREDICTABLE, NOT DIFFUSE. On 6000 random instances the median ratio J_full/J_scalar is 1.000, but the tails run from 0.018 to 41.7. The cause is exact rather than statistical: of the 1367 instances on which the proxy OVERSTATES, every single one has a cheapest alternative that opens a pair which is not currently extremal — the mechanism family 1 was built to exhibit — and not one instance with its extrema fixed produced a ratio below one. The converse fails, as it should: 1597 instances have a moving extremum and 230 of those are still exact. So a moving extremum is necessary and not sufficient, and it is CHECKABLE on the instance in hand before —(5) is trusted. STRONG DUALITY: A SEARCH, NOT A PROOF. The certificate assumes only semidefiniteness, which is why duality is left open. A search over 1054 instances — including a family built with M singular and its null space aligned to the constraint normals, the only structural route to a gap — found none above machine precision, and the adversarial family had the SMALLEST gaps. One counterexample would have settled it; a thousand instances without one settle nothing, and the poster says so.
Fig. 3.  A search for a duality gap over 1054 instances. Nothing reaches the re-check threshold, and the family built to be adversarial has the smallest gaps.
V.  Conclusions

When the extrema can move, the scalar proxy is a bound in neither direction and no constant repairs it. The true alternative set is a finite union of convex pair regions on the real range target, its oracle is a finite conjunction of convex problems, the inner problem has a closed form, and the certificate needs no matrix inverse — so a singular information matrix, which is what a working allocator produces, costs nothing extra. The failure is also diagnosable: on 6000 random instances the proxy overstated only when an extremum moves, which can be checked before it is trusted.
How the numbers were produced

THE TRUE VALUE IS COMPUTED, NOT ESTIMATED. J_full is solved exactly by the shrink–expand decomposition, with the window position obtained in closed form rather than searched — an earlier version scanned only the breakpoints and over-estimated, because the optimum is generally interior. AND IT IS CHECKED AGAINST A SOLVER THAT SHARES NONE OF ITS STRUCTURE. SLSQP is run on the raw variables. A local optimiser can only land at or above the true minimum, so a cell where it lands BELOW would expose a defect; across the cross-checked cells, none did. THE PROVED FAMILIES ARE THE SELF-CHECK. Before any random instance is reported the code must reproduce the published numbers on both families — J_scalar = 1/32 and J_full ≤ 9η/32 on the first, J_scalar = η/(8(1+3η)) and J_full ≥ 1/128 on the second.
